# VesevOS API (generated by `tools/mkapidoc.py`: do not edit by hand)

API version: **1** (`apiVersion` field in `/api/status` and `/api/common`). It changes only for breaking changes; adding fields is always allowed.

## General rules

- **Access:** session cookie after `POST /api/login`. Levels: `public` (no session), `guest`, `operator`, `admin` (each includes the previous). No session: 401 `unauthorized`; role too low: 403 `forbidden`.
- **Response:** JSON. On error always `{"ok":false,"err":"translated text","code":"name"}`; `code` is stable (use it in apps), `err` changes with the language.
- **Error codes** (the HTTP status follows `code`):

| code | HTTP | when |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | 400 | missing or invalid data (nothing changed) |
| `bad_login` | 403 | wrong name, password or code |
| `forbidden` | 403 | role too low or action not allowed |
| `https_only` | 403 | from the home network HTTPS is required |
| `notfound` | 404 | item not found |
| `state` | 409 | unsuitable state (e.g. turning the hotspot off without home Wi-Fi) |
| `toobig` | 413 | data too large |
| `blocked` | 429 | too many errors: IP blocked |
| `off` | 503 | service off or package missing |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | no session (the only case that uses 401) |

- **Limits:** body up to 48 KB; file list 200 items, network scan 40 networks (beyond: `more:true`). Dates in Unix seconds (UTC), durations in seconds, sizes in bytes.
- **Parameters:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. API rule 12: an invalid value must change nothing.
- The **Parameters** and **Errors** columns are read from the code (indicative: the errors listed are those the route gives explicitly, besides the general ones above).
